manifest.author: kody-w
manifest.description: Audits local-versus-global RAPP repo drift, classifies push/pull direction, suggests operator actions, and records rhythm bond events.
manifest.name: @kody-w/bond_rhythm_agent

_audit_override.description: (test-only) inject a synthetic audit dict; skip subprocess.

_bonds_file.description: (test-only) point bonds.json at a sandboxed location.

allow_online.description: If true, audit fetches live offspring data; else uses fixtures.

dry_run.description: Cosmetic — rhythm agent never executes regardless.

repo_filter.description: Restrict pulse to one offspring (name or owner/repo).

repo_root.description: Override path to RAPP repo root.
